name: Remini
tagline: Remini is a mobile AI app that restores and enhances old, blurry, or low-resolution photos using advanced face restoration AI. It can sharpen facial details in degraded photos and transform selfies into AI-generated portraits in various artistic styles. With over 100 million downloads, it is one of the most popular AI photo apps.
